title: Feature Request: telemetry for executive audience / measuring ROI
body:
Wondering, if a company were to pay for CC for all its engineers, what options are available for measuring the ROI / justifying the spend? One specific metric that the company can collect from its own engineers who use CC that would help the executive audience get onboard would be showing what % of a merged PR was authored by CC (and then aggregating this up to a big cohort over time). Is there anything available in CC that can track that or a related number?

Thanks!
author: SinOverCos
